Introducing pmstream.

pmstream can run winamp style visualizations (projectM) in the Linux terminal.

It streams projectm frames delimited by a double line-break. It was made to work with the music player kew, but it can be used stand-alone from the command-line or as a plugin for other apps.

Download here:
https://codeberg.org/ravachol/pmstream
